 ORDER
This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 16.12.2022 by Police Station, Dabra, District Gwalior (M.P.), in connection with crime No.1009/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N) and 506 of IPC.

In brief, prosecution case is that on 24.11.2022 prosecutrix, a married lady, aged about 32 years lodged a computerized complaint at Mahila Thana against present applicant-accused alleging that Ram Sevak Parihar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116116102/

sentences.text: she is resident of Takanpur, Gwalior, at present she resides in the house of present applicant-accused on rent alongwith her daughter Simran Kaur from 20.07.2022.
Present applicant- accused captured her photos and vidoes while prosecutrix was bathing in the bathroom.

Thereafter,
he started black mailing her on the pretext of aforesaid videos and photos and committed sexual intercourse with her.
On 07.10.2022 at about 3 pm, he called her at city center on the pretext that he will delete her photos and videos and took her in the house of Madhav Parihar and again committed sexual intercourse.
Thereafter, he did not delete the videos and photos.
On the complaint of prosecutrix, crime No.1009/2022 for the offence under Sections 376, 376(2)(N) and 506 of IPC was registered.
FIR was registered on 29.11.2022.
Then, she was sent for medical examination.
Present applicant-accused was arrested.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 16.12.2022.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On such premises, learned counsel for the applicant prayed for bail.
Learned counsel for the State as well as complainant opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
It is further submitted that investigation is going on and applicant-accused and his relatives are pressurizing the prosecutrix.
Both the Advocates are heard.
Case diary perused.

Looking to the facts & circumstances of the case, without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash surety of Rs.25,000/- alongwith bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of default, cash surety of Rs. 25,000/- shall stand forfeited automatically.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
